text:
jess: FYI customer reported duplicate provisional tokens after a resumed streaming session. looks like snapshot hysteresis + route fallback overlap. cc @nate

nate: any logs? which pool did it fall back to?

jess: small snippet: 
INFO session=abc123 resume snapshot=SNAP-42 ttl_expired=true route=pool-a fallback=pool-b provisional=48
INFO ledger write provisional session=abc123 tokens=48 origin=resume
INFO ledger write provisional session=abc123 tokens=48 origin=fallback

karen: two writes within 1s. dedupe should've caught it. maybe different derived session ids per pool?

sam: yep, per-pool HMAC difference can cause canonicalization mismatch.

nate: sounds like a race: merge path + routing fallback each call ledger.write. short term: add idempotency in ledger.write keyed by canonical_session_id + origin_hint and emit telemetry when canonicalization absent.

karen: also propose console annotation: mark "resume-hysteresis-collision" on session timeline and show count on route dashboard. ops wants last-seen example ids.

sam: rollout plan: put idempotency + metric behind kill-switch, canary 48h, then global. also run migration to merge provisional duplicates for last 7 days (dry-run first). ops-bot: schedule?

ops-bot: queued job merge-provisional-hysteresis-collisions-v1 (2026-03-15..2026-03-22) dry-run estimate=~12k rows

jess: great. action items: karen PR for ledger idempotency + metric; sam PR for single-merge RPC to avoid concurrent writes; jess will update console UX and support doc. low severity but visible to customers. :thumbsup:
